The PR adds ripgrep stdout/stderr stream-error handling to the grep tool, plus a focused regression test and terminal proof script.

PR surface: Source +13, Tests +74, Other +75. Total +162 across 3 files.

target.title: fix(agents): handle ripgrep stdout/stderr stream errors in grep tool
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The built-in `grep` tool pipes ripgrep's stdout into a `readline.Interface` and attaches a `"data"` listener to stderr, but neither raw stream has an `"error"` listener. If either stream emits an error, readline's internal handler re-throws it as an unhandled exception and crashes the agent tool.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added explicit `"error"` handlers on `child.stdout` and `child.stderr` that close the readline interface, remove the abort listener, and reject the tool promise with the stream error. A no-op `rl.on("error", …)` is added so readline does not re-throw the input stream error after our handler has settled the promise.

## User Impact

Grep tool calls no longer crash on stdout/stderr stream errors; they return a failed result instead.

## Evidence

Regression test:

```bash
pnpm test src/agents/sessions/tools/grep.stream-errors.test.ts
```

```
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  2 passed (2)
```

## Real behavior proof

```bash
node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proof/grep-tool-stream-errors.mts
```

```
=== Proof: grep tool stream error handling ===

PASS (stdout): stream error rejected with "ripgrep stdout error: stdout EPIPE"
PASS (stderr): stream error rejected with "ripgrep stderr error: stderr EPIPE"
```
